description: "Adds the route to the interface's netplan file, such as /etc/netplan/osapi-osapi0-routes.yaml for osapi0, under a netplan definition that is the interface's own, and applies it. A route osapi already has, the same, does not change; one to the same destination by another gateway or metric is refused: update changes it. A default route is refused: the interface behavior sets the gateway. An interface the host does not have is not found. An interface that a match defines, such as cloud-init's all for en*, is refused, because the route would go on each interface the match takes. It runs on the Debian family, and elsewhere, and in a container, reports skipped."

Adds the route to the interface's netplan file, such as /etc/netplan/osapi-osapi0-routes.yaml for osapi0, under a netplan definition that is the interface's own, and applies it. A route osapi already has, the same, does not change; one to the same destination by another gateway or metric is refused: update changes it. A default route is refused: the interface behavior sets the gateway. An interface the host does not have is not found. An interface that a match defines, such as cloud-init's all for en*, is refused, because the route would go on each interface the match takes. It runs on the Debian family, and elsewhere, and in a container, reports skipped.
